values.note: 2026 daily rates plus GST: 30-amp full hookup C$52.50 (no fire pit) or C$55 (fire pit), 50-amp premium full hookup C$65. The rate covers 2 adults and their dependent children. Sani-dump and water fill C$15.75.

note: Lions-club campground in the city of Red Deer with the Red Deer River as its backdrop and a private entrance to the Trans Canada Trail along the river. The 15-amp power-only sites (22-39, 116-117) take tents and very small RVs only; every 30- and 50-amp site is a full-hookup back-in, and most 30-amp sites have no fire pit. --Claude
summary: Operator pages: 2026 rates C$52.50-65 plus GST for sites a 23-ft rig may use (C$40 power-only is tents/very small RVs; base 40 -> 52.5), C$15 reservation fee, extra adult C$10; season May 1 - Sep 30; weekend 2-night / long-weekend 3-night minimums; one-night stays first come; 50-amp FHU and facilities confirmed; stored 28-night maximum cleared.
